WELCOME TO CAPE COAST STAYS

Stay somewhere
that stays with you.

Based in the heart of Bloubergstrand, we bring together beautiful holiday homes and the kind of personal service that makes you feel right at home.

From ocean-view escapes to fully serviced coastal stays, we manage and market short-term rental properties along the Cape coastline. For our guests, memorable getaways. For our owners, professional management and peace of mind.
